card.name: Multiples after a number in dose comparisons
card.fires_on: The word 'times' or '-fold' right after a number, when animal doses or exposures are compared with the human dose. Also fires on 'per' after a number in a concentration.

modes.label: times / -fold after number
modes.description: A multiplier word follows a number in an animal-to-human dose comparison.
modes.example: (9 to 33<< times>> the maximum recommended human dose)

modes.label: per after a count
modes.description: The word 'per' follows a number in a concentration or titer.
modes.example: 4 mL 10 8 (100 million) PFU<< per>> mL Inject any new lesion(s) (
